title: Reliquary plugin manifest
description: The manifest of a Reliquary plugin. The API applies the same rules when the administrator installs a plugin. See docs/architecture/extensions.md.

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for the editors.

id.description: The ID of the plugin: 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The first character is a letter or a digit.

kind.description: The kind of extension. A plugin manifest can omit it.

name.description: The name of the plugin, in English.

description.description: A short description of the plugin, in English.

version.description: The version of the plugin: major.minor.patch, with an optional pre-release part, for example 1.0.0 or 1.0.0-beta.1. Build metadata is not permitted.

coreApi.description: The versions of the core API that the plugin supports, in the range syntax of npm, for example ^1.0. The API also checks the syntax of the range.

entry.description: The path of the JavaScript module of the plugin, relative to the root of the plugin files, for example dist/index.js. A path segment cannot start with a dot.

permissions.description: The scopes of the public API that the plugin asks for. The user accepts them.

slots.description: The interface slots that the plugin uses, for example deck.actions.

items.description: A slot name: two or more parts with a dot between them. Each part has lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and starts with a letter.

network.description: The origins that the plugin can reach. The user accepts them. The CSP of the plugin frame contains only these origins.

items.description: An HTTPS origin, for example https://api.example.com, or a local origin: http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1. An origin can have a port. A wildcard is permitted only for one level, for example https://*.example.com.

devices.description: The devices that the plugin uses. The user accepts them.

accounts.description: The external sites where the user links an account for the plugin.

site.description: The host name of the site, for example moxfield.com. Each site can occur only one time.

auth.description: The authentication method on the site.

sync.description: When the core starts a sync of the linked account. Without this field, the sync is manual.

mode.description: manual: on a click of the user. on-open: when the web app opens. periodic: periodically while the web app is open.

intervalMinutes.description: The interval of a periodic sync, in minutes.

panels.description: The panels of the plugin. Each panel renders in its own sandboxed iframe. The slot of each panel must also be in the field slots.

id.description: The ID of the panel in the plugin: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The first character is a letter. Each ID can occur only one time.

title.description: The title of the panel, in English. The field i18n gives the translations.

formats.description: The import formats and the export formats of the plugin. The plugin converts the file, and the core imports or exports the data.

id.description: The ID of the format in the plugin: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The first character is a letter. Each ID can occur only one time.

direction.description: import: the plugin converts a file into the text of a deck or a collection CSV. export: the plugin converts a deck or a collection into a file.

title.description: The name of the format, in English. The field i18n gives the translations.

extensions.description: The file name extensions of the format, for example .dek.

items.description: A dot, then 1 to 10 lowercase letters and digits.

i18n.description: The translations of the texts of the plugin, for each language. The keys name, description, panels.<id>.title and formats.<id>.title translate the texts of the manifest. The plugin can add its own keys.

propertyNames.description: A language code: two lowercase letters, with an optional region, for example fr or fr-CA.
A text key: parts with a dot between them, for example panels.stats.title. The first part starts with a lowercase letter.

settings.description: The default settings of the plugin for the instance.
